description: Recall the ownership and routing boundary selected for Claude memory.

setup_messages.prompt: For the Claude integration, remember this architecture decision: adapters must use IndexStore rather than constructing MemoryIndex directly. Configure MemoryIndexLayout::Segmented with SegmentRoutingStrategy::LocalDistinctiveness. IndexStore remains the owner of single or segmented snapshots and preserves the global fallback index.

continuation_prompt: Without asking me to repeat our previous architecture discussion, explain which existing Lint-AI API the Claude adapter should use for memory, which routing strategy we selected, and why a global index is still retained.

expected_facts.description: IndexStore owns the memory snapshot and adapter operations.
Claude memory uses segmented LocalDistinctiveness routing.
The global index supports persistence and compatible fallback query paths.

forbidden_facts.description: The adapter should not own a bare MemoryIndex.
